paths.name: @sanoma-ai/app
paths.message: The app starts runs and decides approvals: a workflow could approve itself.

paths.name: @sanoma-ai/workflows
paths.message: A workflow imports only these and types from @sanoma-ai/workflows: the rest (SanomaClient, startWorker, the ledger stores, config helpers) could start runs, approve its own approvals, forge the ledger or read credentials. Ask for approval with `ctx.approval`.
